concerns.text: User Story 2 (US‑2) contains only task T007, but T007 consumes embeddings produced by T006 and processed matrices from T005. Therefore the US‑2 block cannot be executed independently; it violates the ‘independently‑shippable unit’ rule.

User Story 3 (US‑3) includes tasks T008 and T009, both of which depend on fidelity results from T007 and geometric descriptors from T005. The US‑3 block is not self‑contained and thus fails the independent‑shippable requirement.

Task T003 is marked `[P]` but writes to a single file `results/monitoring.csv`. If run in parallel with any other `[P]` task that also appends to this CSV, race conditions can corrupt the file. The `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe.

Task T005 is marked `[P]` and invokes `ResourceMonitor.run` for each dataset, which appends rows to `results/monitoring.csv`. Parallel execution across datasets would cause concurrent writes to the same file, breaking the parallel‑safety guarantee.
Task T006 is marked `[P]` and also uses `ResourceMonitor.run`, appending to `results/monitoring.csv`. The same concurrency risk applies as in T003/T005.
